body:
Queue #2's carried **C1 scaling study** — bounded sub-15min slice, the path-to-nonzero-learning-delta probe.

## What
`tools/c1-scaling.js` runs the page's OWN training loop (the `tools/prerun-coev.js` call sequence into core.js, parameterized) at (population × generations × seed) arms and receipts the trajectories. 7 arms executed, receipt committed at `research/c1-scaling-2026-10-01.json`:
- pop 24/96/192 × 40 gens × 2 seeds + one long arm (pop 96 × 160 gens)
- measured: rally (h2h frames) + sFit first5/last5 windows per arm

First data read (descriptive): seed variance dominates at 40 gens — pop 24 s1 rally 351→694 up, pop 24 s2 455→333 **down**, pop 192 s2 480→271 **down**; the long arm rises 172→849. The R66 selection-noise law holds at every population size on a 40-gen horizon; horizon, not population, is the axis that moves. No learning claim asserted — printed, never believed.

## Honesty architecture (pinned, not promised)
- contract marker pinned IN SOURCE + on every summary (`noLearningClaim`)
- study never touches `checkpoints/coev.js` — the R45 birth seal + canonical artifacts stay the one canonical training set
- `tests/c1-scaling.test.js`: DETERMINISM (same arm twice = deep-equal), SCALING CONTRAST (pop 8 vs 24 diverge at one seed), HONESTY (marker + labels); FAIL-first (tool absent on main)
- VERIFIED_CLAIMS row `c1-scaling-study` (two-way wristband pin); README count 309→312

## Suite ground
304 registered: 296 pass / 0 fail / 8 honest env skips; qa 8/8; build-site resealed before suite counts (wave-66 law); prerun canonical md5s untouched (core.js delta = registry entry only). Main untouched; merge Casey-gated.
